question: In which of the following states are the Palitana temples, a Jain pilgrimage site, located?
solution:
The correct answer is '**__Gujarat__'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Palitana** is an important city of pilgrimage holding the significance of salvation for the Jain community.
 
• It is situated 50 km South-west of **Bhavnagar city** in the state of **Gujarat**. 
 
• Palitana is a city with as many as **823 temples** of different sizes, dedicated to the 24 Tirthankaras or holy saints of the **Jain community**.
 
• The temples are delicately sculpted in marble. The main temple of the first **Tirthankara**, Shree Adishwar has an elaborated architectural pattern.
 
• Since ancient times, it has been said that the number of people who achieved liberation is equal to the number of stones on the **Shatrunjaya hills.**
 
• Therefore, for the Jains, the temples on the **Shatrunjaya hills** are considered the most sacred place of pilgrimage.
 
• Jains believe that **Adinath** sanctified the mountain of Shatrunjaya by selecting it as the site of his first sermon.
 
• The conglomeration of temples was set up in two different time phases-some around the 11th-12th centuries and some around the 16th century.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
